name: Garrison Armory
summary: Alliance miners work the Garrison Armory southwest of Nethergarde Keep. Their ore supplies the fortress and brings wealth to Stormwind.

sections.title: A Lifeline in the Red Wastes
sections.body: Nethergarde Keep must hold its watch over the Dark Portal, and long supply trains from Stormwind cannot meet every need. In the Garrison Armory’s underground mine shafts, miners work under foremen with engineers at their side. Ore mined there goes to Nethergarde’s smiths and fortifications, or travels to Stormwind in trade for food, tools, and other provisions the keep needs.

sections.title: Vulnerable Industry
sections.body: The Garrison Armory lies beyond Nethergarde Keep’s main walls, exposed to the red desert’s dangers. Dreadmaul ogres and wild beasts prowl the surrounding crags. Armed guards protect the workers in the tunnels, for any disruption to the mine threatens the keep’s watch over the blasted frontier.

faq.q: What is the Garrison Armory used for?
aliases: why is there a mine here
faq.answer: Workers at Nethergarde Keep mine metal and minerals in the Garrison Armory. The ore supplies the fortress and is traded to Stormwind for food and equipment.
Nethergarde miners, engineers, and foremen work in the armory. They excavate ore and maintain the shafts under Nethergarde’s command.

faq.q: Why does Nethergarde Keep need this mine?
faq.answer: Nethergarde Keep stands isolated in the desolate Blasted Lands, where regular supply lines are difficult. The mine provides metal to repair gear and reinforce defenses. Excess materials can be traded to Stormwind for vital supplies.

faq.q: Can Horde players enter the Garrison Armory?
faq.answer: The Garrison Armory is held by hostile Alliance workers and guards. Horde adventurers still brave its depths to claim rich ore from the mine shafts.

angles.text: Valuable mineral veins run through the rugged stone beneath the Garrison Armory, making its mine shafts a contested quarry.
The Armory’s workforce labors constantly to keep Nethergarde Keep supplied with weapons, armor, and trade goods for its lonely watch.
